task_language: Make sure all the white mugs are upright so that the opening is facing upwards.

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read ReorientWhiteMugsTask terminations: success = object_upright(object=['upright_white_mug', 'sideways_white_mug'], up_axis='z', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene mugs4_measuringcup_drill_bowl_v2.usda: upright_white_mug, sideways_white_mug among 8 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only. At reset one white mug starts upright and already satisfies its term.

assets_and_frames.basis: Upright is the object's local +z against world up; the witness's upright pose (identity orientation) gives the success termination.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 a566c5fcc3c4): upright -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 a566c5fcc3c4): reset_state -> False; inverted -> False.
